name: Local Piecewise Integration for Light Propagation
definition: A method to efficiently compute the propagation of light from a global light source towards each voxel in a volumetric dataset by approximating the absorption integral using local piecewise linear integration.
summary: Local Piecewise Integration is a precomputation technique that approximates global light transport by storing segment transmittance in a 3D texture, enabling efficient first-order inscattering without full path tracing.
